title: State of Maharashtra v. Mayer Hans George

content.caseIdentity: State of Maharashtra v. Mayer Hans George, AIR 1965 SC 722
content.holding: Statutory offences may exclude mens rea where the statute is clear — typically public-welfare / foreign-exchange type offences. Do not generalise this to the BNS homicide scheme.
content.relevance: The exception that proves the rule. Use only when the section is silent and regulatory.
